title: Old vs New Tax Regime FY 2026-27: Which Is Better at Your Salary? (Break-Even Table)
seoTitle: Old vs New Tax Regime FY 2026-27: Break-Even Table
seoDescription: The new regime is default and tax-free up to a ₹12.75 lakh salary in FY 2026-27. See how much deduction makes the old regime cheaper at each salary.
excerpt: A salary-by-salary break-even table from ₹8 to ₹30 lakh, two worked examples for HRA renters and home-loan borrowers, the new Income-tax Act 2025 section numbers, and the rules for switching regimes.
